title: Northbeam TechWorks Rate Card Reading: Crew Attendance Charges a Contract Does Not Leave
content:
How much of the charge for bringing the crew out is added to a business contract relief on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job turns on how many such charges stand on the job and on what the labour and parts of the dispatch day come to.

**Where a charge for bringing the crew out stands on the job and the labour and parts booked for the day the crew was dispatched reach the figure at which the service waives it**, that charge is added in full — every such charge standing on the job.

**Where such charges stand on the job for more than one attendance**, only the charge booked for the day the crew was dispatched is added.

**Where neither situation holds**, nothing of the charge for bringing the crew out is added.

## The figure at which each service waives the charge

The comparison of the first reading is a not-below-it one: labour and parts of the dispatch day exactly equal to the figure reach it.

| TechWorks service | Labour and parts total at or above which the crew attendance charge is waived, USD |
| --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 0.00 |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 299.00 |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 499.00 |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 399.00 |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 750.00 |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 0.00 |

## The readings side by side

| Charges for bringing the crew out standing on the job | Labour and parts of the dispatch day against the service's figure | Added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| one or more | at or above it | every such charge standing on the job |
| two or more | below it | only the charge booked for the day the crew was dispatched |
| exactly one | below it | nothing |
| none | either | nothing |

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

Take a hypothetical job under TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration, whose waiver figure is 499.00 USD and whose crew attendance charge is 69.00 USD.

**One charge, the dispatch day below the figure.** The labour and parts of the dispatch day come to 284.00 USD and a single charge of 69.00 USD stands on the job. Neither reading applies and nothing is added.

**Two charges, the dispatch day below the figure.** The job carries charges for two attendances, 138.00 USD in all, and the labour and parts of the dispatch day still come to 284.00 USD. Only the one booked for the day the crew was dispatched is added: 69.00 USD.

**Two charges, the dispatch day reaching the figure.** The labour and parts of the dispatch day come to 536.40 USD. The first reading governs and every such charge standing on the job is added: 138.00 USD.
